comparison.objective: Seat a platform on cone, V-groove, and flat kinematic datums; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level lowering and three-point precision seating differ from small-tool use, threaded locking, collar rotation, and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: All three feet must bear on their matching datums with the platform released; candidate requires two safe cycles and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Precision seating tests geometric constraint alignment, not dynamic damping calibration.
